outcomes.name: The process changes has been refined based on pilot learnings
The process changes is understood across every site/team joining the scaled rollout

actions.action: Review pilot feedback on Process & Sustainment to identify what needs to change in the process changes before scaling.
Refine the process changes to Process & Sustainment based on lessons learned from the pilot.
Secure sign-off for the refined process changes covering Process & Sustainment ahead of wider rollout.
Ensure the refined process changes for Process & Sustainment is consistently communicated to new sites/teams joining the rollout.
Continuously validate that the process changes for Process & Sustainment remains effective as the change scales further.
Gather feedback from pilot participants on how the process changes affected Skills & Behaviour.
Adapt the process changes relating to Skills & Behaviour for a wider, more diverse audience.
Roll out the process changes covering Skills & Behaviour to stakeholders in newly onboarding sites/teams.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour among stakeholders in the wider rollout and address any gaps.
Use champions from the pilot to help new sites/teams connect with the process changes for Skills & Behaviour.
